title: Zuri and Bloop's Weather Board
markdown:
Gather 'round, my little adventurers! This is Zuri’s story, and her robot pal, Bloop! Zuri loved to think, and Bloop’s lights went blink-blink-blink when he was excited. "Bleep bloop!" he’d say, meaning, "Hello friend! Let's play!"

One sunny day, Zuri asked, "Bloop, is it always sunny?" She tapped her chin. Bloop whirred. "Good question!"

Suddenly, a big cloud floated by. "Hmm," Zuri hummed. "That cloud is hiding the sun." Bloop’s lights flickered. "Did we see clouds yesterday?" he asked. "Or just sunshine?"

Zuri frowned. "Oh dear! It's tricky! I can't remember if it rained last week! We see things, but then they're gone! Poof!"

Then, Zuri’s eyes lit up like stars! "I have an idea, Bloop! A brilliant idea! We need to write down what we see! We need to make a special record!"

Bloop’s lights flashed. "A record!"

"Even better!" Zuri declared. "A Weather Board! We need paper and colours!"

They grabbed paper and crayons and sat under their big oak tree. Zuri drew a big, happy sun. "Today is sunny!" she announced. Bloop pointed, helping her colour. "Whirr! That spot!"

The next day, fluffy clouds floated by. "Ooh!" Zuri said. "Partly cloudy today!" She drew clouds and wrote the date. Making their record was fun!

On the third day, pitter-patter. Raindrops fell. "Look, Bloop! Rain dots!" Zuri giggled. She drew the rain and a shy sun peeking out.

They kept adding to their Weather Board. They drew windy days, gray days, and a colourful rainbow! Each day was a new picture.

After a week, Zuri looked at their board. "Sunny day!" she pointed. "Partly cloudy! Rainy day!" She realized, "It's not always sunny! Sometimes it rains!"

Bloop whirred happily. "Whirr! Patterns! We see patterns!"

"Exactly!" Zuri cheered. "By drawing what we saw, we made a record to remember! It shows us the weather changes. Our Weather Board helps us read the sky's secret messages!"

Coach Ellis, a kind man, walked by. "What have we here?" he boomed. "A magnificent Weather Board! Brilliant!"

Zuri beamed. "We're recording so we don't forget!"

Coach Ellis chuckled. "That's wonderful! By watching and writing, you're discovering like super-detectives! You're learning to see patterns! That's how scientists learn!"

Zuri and Bloop looked at each other, their minds buzzing. "We are!" Zuri exclaimed. "Super-detectives! I wonder what else we can discover by making a record tomorrow!"

Bloop gave a little whirr-pop! which definitely meant, "Me too!" With their colourful Weather Board, Zuri and Bloop were ready for all the sky’s surprises. Maybe you could make your own Weather Board too? That would be exciting!
characters: Zuri the little coder, Bloop the robot, Coach Ellis
